key_updates: Morpho's live Ethereum FXRP/RLUSD market displays $8.44M outstanding loans, $9.35M total market size, $914.37K liquidity and 90.22% utilization at the captured page observation.
The FXRP/RLUSD market is concentrated: Sentora RLUSD Main supplies 99.04% of displayed RLUSD and the top three borrowers account for 91.00% of displayed debt.
The current $9.35M isolated market must not be confused with Flare's $280M broader Sentora RLUSD Main vault statement from August 3.
Coinbase offers XRP-backed USDC loans through Morpho; Circle is the USDC issuer but is not shown as the lender or collateral manager.
Circle confirms native USDC on XRPL with Circle Mint issuance/redemption and cross-chain swap support. This is a direct Circle-XRPL relationship, not native XRP demand.

Circle Arc launched September 16 with USDC gas; SBI Group is in the founding validator cohort, Coinbase and Binance are named exchange participants, BitGo is a custody provider, and Morpho/Aave are credit protocols.
SBI Remit's JPY 2.5T cumulative remittance total as of May 27 is company-wide, not XRP ODL volume. Ripple confirms one commercialized XRP ODL corridor, but corridor volume is undisclosed.
SBI Group has documented relationships with both Circle/USDC/Arc and Ripple/RLUSD/XRP, alongside Nium and Fasset remittance partnerships. This is multi-rail positioning, not exclusivity.
Circle/ACI's October 27 Colombia pilot integrates USDC with existing Bre-B payment infrastructure; no XRP is identified.
